purpose: Document first-party local registry context and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Bamenda City Council’s official urban-development page documents city cartographic and cadastre-coordination responsibilities. MINDCAF’s official materials document the national cadastral authority and its regional/departemental service structure. No safe anonymous first-party parcel ID plus full geometry response, schema, or CRS was obtained. The city page presented a Cloudflare challenge; the official MINMIDT mining-cadastre announcement timed out when fetched; neither is evidence of parcel absence.
registryAssessment: A city-level urban-development/cadastre coordination role is evidenced, but a city-specific registry custodian or public ordinary-land parcel service is not independently established. MINDCAF is evidenced as the national cadastral authority.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Bamenda City Council page says the urban-development department develops and monitors city cartographic projects and cadastre operations in coordination with cadastre services. The ordinary request returned a Cloudflare interactive challenge.

Official MINDCAF material describes cadastral functions and regional/departemental services, including cadastral plans, cadastral registers, cadastral extracts, and map maintenance. No public Bamenda vector service was linked.
French official MINDCAF document page reviewed for local-language first-party cadastral context; no Bamenda-specific public parcel API was exposed.
Official MINMIDT announcement describes the online National Mining Cadastre Map. It is not treated as ordinary land-parcel geometry evidence; fetch timed out in this attempt.
